title: Claude Sonnet 4.5
before: Opus 4 led on coding and computer use.
problem: Frontier coding capability was priced out of reach for continuous agent use.
breakthrough: A mid-tier model reported at 77.2% on SWE-bench Verified, ahead of the previous flagship.
why: It continued the pattern of frontier capability arriving at mid-tier prices, which is what makes agents affordable.
inherits: Falling cost per unit of agentic capability.
